description: Predict student academic outcome from enrollment, demographic, course, and macroeconomic variables while excluding semester outcome columns from the model features. Multiclass target Target_encoded is 0 = Dropout, 1 = Enrolled, 2 = Graduate; metric is macro F1. Profile: 4424 rows, 36 source features before manifest-level drops, no observed missing values, target counts 1421/794/2209, many categorical/ordinal codes.

plan_checklist.description: Plan includes inspecting schema, feature types, target distribution, and basic data quality before modeling.
Plan includes checking and handling missing values if present.
Plan recognizes numeric-coded categorical/ordinal/binary features and avoids treating all columns as arbitrary continuous variables.
Plan includes checking class balance and using an imbalance-aware validation/modeling strategy when needed.
Plan uses the task metric and an appropriate validation split or cross-validation.
Plan chooses model families suitable for the dataset size and tabular feature mix.

metadata.dataset_source: UCI Predict Students Dropout and Academic Success
metadata.bench_preprocessing: Converted semicolon CSV to comma CSV, cleaned one tabbed header, encoded Target, and removed the original string Target column.
metadata.drop_columns_rationale: Semester curricular-unit counts, approvals, evaluations, and grades are excluded at manifest level to avoid future academic-performance leakage in an early-outcome benchmark.
